name: @lf/web
description: The six bundled plugins (fetch a page, scan a message for links worth fetching, find a person's profile, read what they are doing now, find a company's own site, research a subject) as one plugin module. Loaded in process by the platform with its own tools, served by serve-module everywhere else with the standalone tools (Anthropic, Bright Data, a plain fetch). Its tests borrow apps/api's jest runner (jest.config.borrowed.cjs)
